# Low-poly animal tokens

Transparent PNG sprites rendered on the existing board canvas (not 3D mesh files).
Team mapping: cat = Red, dog = Blue, chicken = Yellow, pig = Green.
Created with the built-in image generation tool from the approved concept image.

## Extraction prompts

Each image used this prompt with its animal and base color:

Extract ONLY the [ANIMAL] from the reference image as one isolated game sprite.
Preserve exactly its cute low-poly design, pose, faceted geometry, colors, face,
camera angle and complete [COLOR] pedestal. Remove all other animals and background.
Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor or surrounding shadow, no text.
Center full uncut character and pedestal with tight consistent padding, high resolution PNG.

- dog.png: DOG (leftmost animal with blue base), blue.
- cat.png: CAT (second animal from left with red rose base), rose red.
- chicken.png: CHICKEN (third animal from left with yellow base), yellow.
- pig.png: PIG (rightmost animal with mint green base), mint green.
